## Variables

### var ErrLength

```go
var ErrLength = errors.New("encoding/hex: odd length hex string")
```

ErrLength reports an attempt to decode an odd-length input using [Decode](hex.md#func-decode) or [DecodeString](hex.md#func-decodestring). The stream-based Decoder returns [io.ErrUnexpectedEOF](../io.md#var-errunexpectedeof) instead of ErrLength.

## Functions

### func AppendDecode

```go
func AppendDecode(dst []byte, src []byte) ([]byte, error)
```

AppendDecode appends the hexadecimally decoded src to dst and returns the extended buffer. If the input is malformed, it returns the partially decoded src and an error.

### func AppendEncode

```go
func AppendEncode(dst []byte, src []byte) []byte
```

AppendEncode appends the hexadecimally encoded src to dst and returns the extended buffer.

### func Decode

```go
func Decode(dst []byte, src []byte) (int, error)
```

Decode decodes src into [DecodedLen](hex.md#func-decodedlen)(len(src)) bytes, returning the actual number of bytes written to dst.

Decode expects that src contains only hexadecimal characters and that src has even length. If the input is malformed, Decode returns the number of bytes decoded before the error.

### func DecodeString

```go
func DecodeString(text string) ([]byte, error)
```

DecodeString returns the bytes represented by the hexadecimal string s.

DecodeString expects that src contains only hexadecimal characters and that src has even length. If the input is malformed, DecodeString returns the bytes decoded before the error.

### func DecodedLen

```go
func DecodedLen(n int) int
```

DecodedLen returns the length of a decoding of x source bytes. Specifically, it returns x / 2.

### func Dump

```go
func Dump(data []byte) string
```

Dump returns a string containing a canonical hexadecimal and ASCII dump.

### func Dumper

```go
func Dumper(w io.Writer) io.WriteCloser
```

Dumper returns a writer that writes a canonical hexadecimal and ASCII dump.

### func Encode

```go
func Encode(dst []byte, src []byte) int
```

Encode encodes src into [EncodedLen](hex.md#func-encodedlen)(len(src)) bytes of dst. As a convenience, it returns the number of bytes written to dst, but this value is always [EncodedLen](hex.md#func-encodedlen)(len(src)). Encode implements hexadecimal encoding.

### func EncodeToString

```go
func EncodeToString(src []byte) string
```

EncodeToString returns the hexadecimal encoding of src.

### func EncodedLen

```go
func EncodedLen(n int) int
```

EncodedLen returns the length of an encoding of n source bytes. Specifically, it returns n \* 2.

### func NewDecoder

```go
func NewDecoder(r io.Reader) io.Reader
```

NewDecoder returns an [io.Reader](../io.md#type-reader) that decodes hexadecimal characters from r. NewDecoder expects that r contain only an even number of hexadecimal characters.

### func NewEncoder

```go
func NewEncoder(w io.Writer) io.Writer
```

NewEncoder returns an [io.Writer](../io.md#type-writer) that writes lowercase hexadecimal characters to w.
